frequency_question: What proportion of major industrial financial schemes are fully finalized and gazetted within 12 months of initial public announcement?
membership_rule: Includes any centrally sponsored capital subsidy, interest subvention, or credit guarantee scheme for a distinct manufacturing or transport sector launched via official gazette notification. Excludes minor scheme modifications or non-financial policy guidelines.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major schemes; universe of comparable high-priority industrial incentive schemes is approximately 8-10 in this decade.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller sub-schemes handled solely at the joint secretary level without Cabinet/finance concurrence.
skeleton: Decomposed into standard administrative phases: drafting (60 days), inter-ministerial/Cabinet consultation (90 days), financial vetting/expenditure finance committee approval (60 days), and final gazette notification (30 days), totaling 240 days of sequential process time.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 documented major schemes meeting the timeline criterion when prioritized by administrative mandate.
validity_reason: Administrative procedures for scheme formulation, Cabinet approval, and gazette notification under the standard Manual of Office Procedure remain stable across multiple years.
